content.text: As part of the work to support organizational hierarchy for Glofox, we need to align on how the Glofox namespace and corporate structure should be modeled and consumed end to end.
From the data perspective, the proposed approach is to map:

--DimOrganizations
--DimClub
-- PROD replacement: use DimOrganizations and DimClub.
-- Adhoc goal:
-- 1) Seed missing organizations in DimOrganizations from Glofox staging.
-- 2) Update DimClub to map clubs to the correct organization key/name.
-- 3) Output the final dataset used as input for the app-side DimClub update.
-- NOTE: This script is scoped to test tables (*_giuseppe_*). Run blocks in order.
-- NOTE: corp_Test filter is temporary test scope and must be removed/generalized.

-- Step 1: Insert organizations not yet present in the test organizations table.
-- Join key: OrganizationGroupName -> DimOrganizationGroup.OrganizationGroupKey.
-- Writes: OrganizationName, InsertDt, InsightsAnalyze, FitnessBI, GroupingDatabaseName, OrganizationGroupKey.
INSERT dimfact.DimOrganizations ( OrganizationName, InsertDt, InsightsAnalyze, FitnessBI
                                              , GroupingDatabaseName, OrganizationGroupKey)
SELECT org.OrganizationName           AS OrganizationName
     , org.InsertDt                   AS InsertDt
     , 0                              AS InsightsAnalyze
     , 0                              AS FitnessBI
     , 'FitnessBI'                    AS GroupingDatabaseName
     , org_group.OrganizationGroupKey AS OrganizationGroupKey
FROM Glofox.stg_glofox_organization org
         INNER JOIN dimfact.DimOrganizationGroup org_group
                    ON org_group.OrganizationGroupName = org.OrganizationGroupName
WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM dimfact.DimOrganizations src WHERE src.OrganizationName = org.OrganizationName )
  AND org.OrganizationGroupName = 'corp_Test' -- REMOVE AFTER TEST


-- Step 2: Update test clubs with organization name/key derived from stg_clubs.namespace.
-- Join keys:
-- - stg_clubs.id = DimClub.Glofox_ClubNumber
-- - DimOrganizations.OrganizationName = stg_clubs.namespace
-- Writes: DimClub.OrganizationName, DimClub.Organization_Key.
UPDATE c
SET OrganizationName = stg_c.namespace
  , Organization_Key = org.OrganizationKey
FROM dimfact.DimClub c
         INNER JOIN Glofox.stg_clubs stg_c ON stg_c.id = c.Glofox_ClubNumber
         INNER JOIN dimfact.DimOrganizations org ON org.OrganizationName = stg_c.namespace
         INNER JOIN dimfact.DimOrganizationGroup org_group ON org_group.OrganizationGroupKey = org.OrganizationGroupKey
WHERE c.SourceNm = 'GloFox'
  AND org_group.OrganizationGroupName = 'corp_Test' -- REMOVE AFTER TEST


-- Step 3 (read-only): Validation/output dataset for app-side DimClub update process.
-- No data changes in this block; this SELECT is the expected handoff payload.
SELECT c.Club_Key
     , c.OrganizationName
     , c.Organization_Key
FROM dimfact.DimClub c
         INNER JOIN Glofox.stg_clubs stg_c ON stg_c.id = c.Glofox_ClubNumber
         INNER JOIN dimfact.DimOrganizations org ON org.OrganizationName = stg_c.namespace
         INNER JOIN dimfact.DimOrganizationGroup org_group ON org_group.OrganizationGroupKey = org.OrganizationGroupKey
WHERE c.SourceNm = 'GloFox'
  AND org_group.OrganizationGroupName = 'corp_Test' -- REMOVE AFTER TEST
